title: More Than a Builder Warranty: How Tri Pointe Homes Austin Cares for Homeowners After Closing
body_markdown:
Closing day may mark the end of the homebuying journey, but at Tri Pointe Homes®, it is only the beginning of the homeowner relationship.


Once the keys are handed over, the Tri Pointe Homes Austin Customer Care team becomes a trusted resource for warranty questions, home maintenance guidance and everything in between. The goal is not to only be there when something goes wrong. It is to help homeowners understand their new home, feel confident caring for it and prevent routine maintenance needs from becoming larger concerns.


That approach has made Austin a standout within Tri Pointe Homes. The division consistently earns higher Customer Care scores than other divisions—a reflection of the team’s responsiveness, personal relationships and commitment to supporting homeowners long after they move in.


## A Builder Warranty Made Simple


Every new Tri Pointe home in Texas includes warranty coverage designed to protect homeowners during the years after closing:


-


**One year of materials and workmanship coverage**


-


**Two years of coverage for major mechanical delivery systems** , including plumbing, electrical, heating and air conditioning


-


**10 years of structural coverage** for major components such as the foundation, framing and roof framing system


Some products may also include separate manufacturer warranties. Coverage details, exclusions and homeowner responsibilities are outlined in the warranty documents provided with each home. Whenever homeowners are unsure where an issue belongs or how to begin, the Austin Customer Care team is there to help guide them.


## Customer Care Starts Before Closing


One reason the Austin team delivers such a personalized experience is that Customer Care representatives often get to know homeowners before they receive their keys.


Representatives are integrated into the community and participate in meetings throughout the homebuying process. By closing day, the Customer Care representative may already understand the buyer’s story, know the construction team and be familiar with the home itself.


That continuity matters. When an Austin homeowner submits a request, it is not routed to a stranger who has no connection to the community. Each community has a dedicated Customer Care representative who understands the neighborhood, works closely with its construction team and becomes a familiar point of contact for its homeowners.


Tri Pointe Homes Austin works hard to maintain enough Customer Care coverage for every community and keep representatives in those communities long term. The result is a level of familiarity and accountability that can be difficult to find in a traditional warranty experience.


## Three Proactive Check-Ins During the First Year


Homeowners should not have to wait for a concern to arise before hearing from their builder. That is why the Customer Care team schedules three dedicated meetings throughout the first year of homeownership:


-


**Around 30 days after closing:** The homeowner meets with Customer Care and the construction manager to discuss the home and address early questions.


-


**Around six months after closing:** The team checks in again, reviews how the home is performing and answers new questions that may have come up.


-


**Around 11 months after closing:** Customer Care helps ensure that covered first-year items have been identified and that there are no outstanding concerns as the homeowner approaches the one-year anniversary.


These meetings create clear, convenient opportunities to talk through questions with people who know the home. They also help homeowners become more comfortable with the features, systems and maintenance needs that come with homeownership.


## Responsive Help When Homeowners Need It


Homeowners can submit Customer Care requests through the same Tri Pointe Homes app they used during the homebuying process. The homeowner portal brings important documents, paperwork, orientation materials, requests and communication together in one convenient place.


Tri Pointe Homes Austin prides itself on responding to every Customer Care request within 24 hours. A prompt response does more than move a request forward—it reassures homeowners that their concern has been received, documented and placed in the hands of someone who knows their community.


Homeowners are not left wondering who to contact or whether someone will respond. They have a clear process, a dedicated representative and a local team committed to helping them find the right next step.


## Teaching Homeowners, Not Just Completing Repairs


Some of the most valuable support Customer Care provides does not involve a warranty repair at all.


Owning a home comes with regular maintenance, and many buyers—especially first-time homeowners—may feel overwhelmed with new tasks. The Austin Customer Care team sees homeowner education as an important part of its role. The goal is to help homeowners understand why maintenance matters, how to complete basic tasks and what they can do to keep their home and its systems performing properly.


Tri Pointe Homes provides website resources, how-to videos and maintenance guidance through the homeowner portal. The Austin team frequently shares those resources and, when helpful, a representative may visit the home to demonstrate how to complete a task in person.


Common topics include:


-


Refreshing caulk around baseboards and windows as materials naturally expand, contract and settle


-


Maintaining healthy grass and proper drainage around the home


-


Choosing lawn-care and fertilizer products


-


Caring for plumbing and air conditioning systems


-


Replacing the appropriate air filter on the recommended schedule


-


Helping prevent algae buildup in applicable air conditioning drain systems


-


Planning home projects such as applying epoxy to a garage floor


For example, concrete naturally develops some cracking over time. A homeowner interested in adding an epoxy garage floor may benefit from waiting until around the home’s first anniversary, allowing time for normal early movement and settling before completing the project. It is a small piece of guidance that may help the homeowner get better long-term results.


That is the difference between simply closing a ticket and truly caring for a homeowner. Austin representatives take the time to explain what is happening, why it is happening and what the homeowner can do next.


## Support for Urgent Warranty Concerns


Most requests can be submitted through the homeowner portal and addressed during regular business hours. Some situations, however, require immediate guidance. Potential warranty emergencies may include:


-


A complete air conditioning shutdown


-


A water leak inside the home that requires the water to be shut off at the curb


-


A total loss of power limited to the home and not connected to a broader outage or weather event


Tri Pointe Homes Austin has a dedicated on-call representative available to document urgent warranty reports and help direct homeowners to the appropriate service—even in the middle of the night. The information is then provided to the homeowner’s dedicated Customer Care representative for follow-up.


If there is an immediate threat to personal safety, homeowners should always contact emergency services or the appropriate utility provider first.


## A Relationship That Continues After the Warranty Check-Ins


The scheduled meetings may end after the first year, but Austin homeowners can continue to turn to Customer Care for help and resources. Some reach out five or six years after closing with questions about original paint colors, maintenance recommendations or where to find information about a particular home feature.


The team is still there to help.


That long-term availability reflects the kind of homeowner experience Tri Pointe Homes Austin works to provide. Customer Care is not an unseen department that only appears when a form is submitted. Its representatives are part of the communities they serve, connected to the people who built the homes and invested in the homeowners who live in them.


## Homeowner Care That Stands Out


A strong builder warranty provides valuable protection. An outstanding Customer Care team makes that protection easier to understand, access and use.


Through dedicated community representatives, proactive first-year meetings, 24-hour response goals, convenient digital tools and hands-on homeowner education, Tri Pointe Homes Austin has built a Customer Care experience that provides homeowners confidence in knowing they have a responsive local team in their corner.


For Tri Pointe homeowners in Austin, support does not stop at closing. It is part of the experience of coming home.


Already a Tri Pointe homeowner? Visit the homeowner portal in the Tri Pointe Homes app or explore the[Homeowner Resources](https://www.tripointehomes.com/homeowners) page for maintenance guidance, how-to videos and Customer Care support.
